principles: rollback readiness is separate from current serving health
a remembered deployment id is not enough to claim recovery readiness
repo-local GitHub OIDC proves whether the exact rollback commit still exists in the registered private repository
targets without a prior qualified canonical release are history-building, not failed
Railway native image rollback availability is not claimed without fresh provider evidence
Defence recommends and verifies rollback targets but never performs rollback automatically
a still-fresh proof that the current rollback commit was the immediately prior canonical commit may carry forward until an exact current-pair repo attestation replaces it
